lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Five distinct, thin white vertical line segments are visible across the primary dark-furred torso, spaced with approximate regularity at roughly 15% of the total torso length apart.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and fourth vertical lines from the anterior show significant fading and discontinuity in the mid-torso region, failing to reach the ventral boundary.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate curvature, projecting upwards and outwards from the frontal bone before curving medially at the terminal ends; the initial vector angle is approximately 65 degrees relative to the dorsal plane of the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.8 times the horizontal pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is localized to approximately the terminal 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-contrast white dorsal crest of long hairs extends from the neck to the rump; distinct ochre-to-orange pigmentation is visible on the lower limbs below the carpal and tarsal joints.
